title: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 해양에서 발생한 재난의 긴급구조활동 평가 및 긴급구조교육에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Relationship with Other Statutes or Regulations) Except as otherwise specifically provided by another statute or regulation, the evaluation of emergency rescue activities of emergency rescue support agencies in response to disasters occurring at sea, and education on emergency rescue for persons engaged in emergency rescue and disaster management duties, shall be governed by these Rules. <Amended on July 9, 2026>
